An independent report on context windows

This report looks at how organisations use models with long context windows in practice. We interviewed forty teams that adopted such models over the last year, from law firms to software companies, and asked what they feed the models, how they check the answers and where the models still let them down.

Most teams said the biggest gain was time saved on first drafts and on finding the right part of a long file. Fewer than half had a written process for checking answers, and several had found errors only after a customer complained. We recommend that every team keep a sample of answers for review by a person.
